states.loadingSubtitle: Gathering roster performance and active assignment metrics.

tooltips.activeMembersDesc: Total number of members actively enrolled under your coaching supervision with valid relationship status.
tooltips.activeMembersCalc: COUNT(members WHERE status = 'ACTIVE' AND coachId = user.id)
tooltips.activeMembersLimit: Excludes pending invitations and archived athletes.
tooltips.pendingInvitesDesc: Invitations sent by you to prospective athletes awaiting their acceptance.
tooltips.pendingInvitesCalc: COUNT(invitations WHERE status = 'PENDING' AND coachId = user.id)
tooltips.pendingInvitesLimit: Cancelled or expired invitations are excluded.
tooltips.sessionsWeekDesc: Total completed workouts recorded across your entire active roster within the current calendar week.
tooltips.sessionsWeekCalc: COUNT(sessions WHERE status = 'COMPLETED' AND week = currentWeek)
tooltips.sessionsWeekLimit: In-progress, skipped, or abandoned sessions are excluded.
tooltips.expiringDesc: Active workout assignments with an end date within the next 7 calendar days.
tooltips.expiringCalc: COUNT(assignments WHERE status = 'ACTIVE' AND endDate <= now() + 7 days)
tooltips.expiringLimit: Does not track assignments without an explicit expiration date.

analyticsView.title: Roster Performance Analytics
analyticsView.subtitle: 30-day aggregated performance, adherence, and velocity telemetry
analyticsView.bottomPrompt: Looking to make changes to your athletes or training programs?
analyticsView.workoutSessionsSub: Completed daily workout output across all athletes
analyticsView.completionRateSub: Daily percentage of started sessions completed
analyticsView.noSessionTelemetry: No session telemetry recorded for this period
analyticsView.createAssignmentsPrompt: Create assignments to see status distribution
analyticsView.assignedMembersPrompt: Assigned members will appear as they complete workouts

tooltips.sessionsDesc: Daily count of completed workout sessions logged by athletes assigned to you.
tooltips.sessionsCalc: COUNT(sessions WHERE status = 'COMPLETED') per calendar day
tooltips.sessionsLimit: Zero-padded for days with no activity across your roster.
tooltips.completionDesc: Daily ratio of completed sessions to started sessions across all assigned members.
tooltips.completionCalc: (Completed Sessions / Total Started Sessions) × 100 on each calendar date
tooltips.completionLimit: On days with zero started sessions, adherence is reported as 0% or neutral.
tooltips.velocityDesc: Number of new workout assignments dispatched to members each day.
tooltips.velocityCalc: COUNT(assignments WHERE createdAt = date) per day
tooltips.velocityLimit: Tracks assignment creation volume; does not measure active assignment duration.
tooltips.distributionDesc: Operational distribution of workout assignments across your athlete roster by status: Active, Completed, or Cancelled.
tooltips.distributionCalc: COUNT(assignments) grouped by status / total assignments × 100
tooltips.distributionLimit: Cancelled assignments include workouts aborted by athlete or coach with reason.
tooltips.rankingDesc: Leaderboard of your assigned members ranked horizontally by total completed workout sessions.
tooltips.rankingCalc: COUNT(sessions WHERE memberId = user.id AND status = 'COMPLETED') DESC
tooltips.rankingLimit: Limited to members in your active training roster.
